review_description: I can not say much more as my solar has not been installed.

Installers arrived on designated day with the wrong brackets for my roof.   On their 2nd visit, different installers (inexperienced) had the correct brackets and proceeded to install after asking me where I wanted to put the system, I wanted and needed their advice!   The installers did not have much pride in their workmanship:- One array too close to the gutters, swarf and clippings left on roof, cable saddles not seated properly.
All of the warranties on the products are with the manufactures and not the GPS Solar so if they disappear your warranty is still good. I got a SMA inverter and 250W Canadian Panels.
Solarquotes was very helpful as there is a lot of companies and systems to choose from.
